facts.text: Notion covers change with window width, so there is no single best size; Notion recommends at least 1,500 px wide.

source.quote: The cover images are dynamic depending on the width of your window, so there's no specific size that works best. That said, we recommend using images at least 1,500 pixels wide.

items.notes: The 1500 px width matches. Notion says there is no specific size or ratio, so pixohub's 600 px height (5:2) is not official.

facts.text: You can pick up to 9 photos at once from the album for a chat or a Moments post.

source.quote: Tap「+」and select「Album」in a chat, or tap「Choose from Album」in Moments. Select up to 9 photos by tapping the desired ones.

facts.text: WeChat compresses image messages to about 50–200 KB per image, depending on the original quality.

source.quote: Image messages: Compressed to 50–200 KB per image, depending on original quality

facts.text: The Moments album cover (the image at the top of your Moments page) has a recommended size of 640 x 640 px.

source.quote: The recommended pixel size for an album cover is 640 x 640.

items.notes: no official source found.

source.title: Cover Image Guidelines for Kindle eBooks
source.quote: Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF (non-animated), TIFF. ... Minimum dimension: at least 500 pixels on the longest side. ... Maximum dimension: 10,000 pixels or fewer on each side | Maximum file size: 50 MB ... Recommended (for best quality) | Dimensions: 2,560 pixels in height x 1,600 pixels in width ... DPI (Dots Per Inch): 300 DPI/PPI resolution minimum

facts.text: Recommended cover size is 2,560 px tall x 1,600 px wide; 2,500 px tall is advised for HD devices.

source.quote: Dimensions: 2,560 pixels in height x 1,600 pixels in width ... Note: For best quality, particularly on high-definition devices, your image should be 2500 pixels in height

facts.text: The cover must be at least 500 px on its longest side (smaller covers are not shown on the website) and 10,000 px or less on each side.

source.quote: Minimum dimension: at least 500 pixels on the longest side. Covers below this threshold are not displayed on the website. Maximum dimension: 10,000 pixels or fewer on each side

facts.text: Maximum file size 50 MB; maximum aspect ratio 500:1; formats JPEG, PNG, non-animated GIF and TIFF (no SVG). JPEG is preferred.

source.quote: Maximum file size: 50 MB ... Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF (non-animated), TIFF. Note: SVG files are not supported

facts.text: RGB is recommended; CMYK files are accepted and converted to RGB automatically.

source.quote: Color mode: RGB is recommended. CMYK files are accepted and converted to RGB automatically

facts.text: KDP recommends at least 300 DPI/PPI.

source.quote: DPI (Dots Per Inch): 300 DPI/PPI resolution minimum

facts.text: Covers smaller than 2560 x 1600 trigger a warning at upload; don't stretch a small image to meet the size.

source.quote: If the marketing cover image size is smaller than the 2560 x 1600 recommendation, a warning is displayed at time of upload. ... Do not stretch the image to meet the size requirements, because this may lower the image quality.

facts.text: Covers with white or very light backgrounds can disappear on Amazon's white page; KDP suggests a 3-4 px medium-gray border.

source.quote: Try adding a narrow (3-4 pixel) border in medium gray to define the boundaries of the cover

source.title: Awareness Image Ad Specs on Facebook Feed | Facebook Ads Guide
source.quote: File Type: JPG or PNG | Ratio: 4:5 | Resolution: 1440 x 1800 pixels | Maximum File Size: 30MB | Minimum Width: 600 pixels

facts.text: Facebook Feed image ads: JPG or PNG, recommended 1440 x 1800 px (4:5), 30 MB maximum, minimum width 600 px, minimum height 750 px at 4:5, 3% aspect ratio tolerance.

source.quote: Minimum Width: 600 pixels ... Minimum Height: 4:5 ratio - 750 pixels ... Aspect Ratio Tolerance: 3%

items.notes: The Ads Guide feed page no longer lists 1:1 as the recommended ratio; it recommends 4:5 at 1440x1800. The Facebook Marketplace ad page (https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/image/facebook-marketplace) still says 'Ratio: 1:1 | Resolution: At least 1080 x 1080 pixels'.

facts.text: Instagram recommends 420 x 654 px (1:1.55) for reel cover photos, and the cover can't be edited after upload.

source.quote: The recommended size for cover photos is 420px by 654px (or 1:1.55 ratio).

facts.text: Reels can be uploaded at aspect ratios from 1.91:1 to 9:16, with a minimum of 30 FPS and 720 px resolution.

source.quote: You can upload a reel with an aspect ratio between 1.91:1 and 9:16.

facts.text: Meta's ads guide for Instagram Reels recommends 1440 x 2560 px (9:16) and leaving at least 14% at the top, 35% at the bottom and 6% on each side free of text, logos and other key elements.

source.quote: Consider leaving at least 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom, and 6% on each side of your asset

items.notes: no official source found for the Reels cover image size. For Reels image ads, the Meta Ads Guide (https://www.facebook.com/business/ads-guide/update/image/instagram-reels) says 'Ratio: 9:16 | Resolution: 1440 x 2560 pixels | Minimum Width: 500 pixels'.

source.title: Add custom thumbnails on YouTube - Computer - YouTube Help
source.quote: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos and 2160 x 3840 for Shorts, with a minimum width of 640 pixels for videos and a minimum height of 640 pixels for Shorts. ... For Shorts, try to upload a thumbnail with an aspect ratio of 9:16.

facts.text: YouTube currently recommends custom thumbnails at 3840 x 2160 px for videos and 2160 x 3840 px for Shorts, with a minimum width of 640 px (videos) or minimum height of 640 px (Shorts), in formats such as JPG or PNG.

source.quote: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos and 2160 x 3840 for Shorts, with a minimum width of 640 pixels for videos and a minimum height of 640 pixels for Shorts. Be uploaded in image formats such as JPG or PNG.

facts.text: File size limits depend on the device: 2 MB for video thumbnails uploaded on mobile (10 MB for podcasts), 50 MB on desktop.

source.quote: Mobile: 2 MB for video thumbnails or 10 MB for podcasts. Desktop: 50MB for video, Shorts, and podcast thumbnails.

facts.text: Aim for 16:9 for videos, 9:16 for Shorts and 1:1 for podcast playlists. A vertical video with a 16:9 custom thumbnail gets an auto-generated 4:5 thumbnail on Home, Explore and Subscriptions instead.

source.quote: Vertical videos with 16:9 custom thumbnails will be replaced by an auto-generated 4:5 thumbnail on the home, explore, and subscription pages.

facts.text: Custom Shorts thumbnails can currently only be added in YouTube Studio on a computer.

source.quote: Custom thumbnails for Shorts are currently only available to add in YouTube Studio on a computer.

items.notes: Same 9:16 ratio; YouTube recommends 2160x3840, not 1080x1920.

source.title: Add end screens to videos - YouTube Help
source.quote: You can add up to four elements to your end screen for videos with standard 16:9 aspect ratio. ... If you use a custom image, we recommend using an image that's at least 300 x 300 pixel width.

facts.text: End screens go in the last 5-20 seconds of a video at least 25 seconds long; custom images should be at least 300 x 300 px; up to four elements on 16:9 videos.

source.quote: If you use a custom image, we recommend using an image that's at least 300 x 300 pixel width.

facts.text: YouTube asks you to leave space and time at the end of the video for end screen elements (no pixel safe area is documented).

source.quote: Make sure you leave enough space and time at the end of the video for an end screen.

items.notes: An end screen is part of the video itself, and YouTube publishes no end-screen canvas size; 1280x720 just matches the 16:9 standard. YouTube's only image spec here is custom element images of at least 300x300.

source.title: Create a LinkedIn Event | LinkedIn Help
source.quote: You can use different banner sizes including 480x270 or 1280x720 pixels. The minimum width is 480 pixels, and the aspect ratio must be 16:9.

facts.text: Event cover images must be 16:9 with a minimum width of 480 px (e.g. 480 x 270 or 1280 x 720).

source.quote: You can use different banner sizes including 480x270 or 1280x720 pixels. The minimum width is 480 pixels, and the aspect ratio must be 16:9.

official.aspect_ratio: Shorter than 1:2 (width:height), taller than 1.91:1; recommended 1:1 or vertical (2:3, 4:5, or 9:16)

source.title: Review ad specs | Pinterest Business help
source.quote: Max file size | Up to 2GB | Video length | Minimum 4 seconds, maximum 15 minutes ... Aspect ratio | Shorter than 1:2 (width:height), taller than 1.91:1. We recommend making your videos square (1:1) or vertical (2:3, 4:5, or 9:16).

facts.text: Keep text and key elements clear of 270 px at the top, 65 px left, 195 px right and 790 px at the bottom so they're visible on any device.

source.quote: Put text and other elements within the dimensions below so users can easily see on any device when viewing. Top : 270 px Left: 65 px Right : 195 px Bottom : 790 px

facts.text: Video Pins: MP4 or M4V on web (also MOV in the apps), H.264 or H.265, 4 seconds to 5 minutes; 9:16 / 1080 x 1920 recommended for full-bleed, with 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 or 1:1 also allowed.

source.quote: Video length Minimum 4 seconds, maximum 5 minutes Aspect ratio For full-bleed videos (or videos that take up the entire screen), we recommend using a 9:16 ratio or 1080x1920 pixel size. Other options include: 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, or 1:1.

facts.text: Standard video ads: up to 2 GB, 4 seconds to 15 minutes, aspect ratio between 1:2 and 1.91:1; square or vertical (2:3, 4:5, 9:16) recommended.

source.quote: Max file size Up to 2GB Video length Minimum 4 seconds, maximum 15 minutes ... Aspect ratio Shorter than 1:2 (width:height), taller than 1.91:1. We recommend making your videos square (1:1) or vertical (2:3, 4:5, or 9:16).

items.notes: 9:16 is one of the recommended ratios, but the standard video Pin spec gives no pixel size. (Separately, full-screen 'premiere spotlight' type formats on the same page state 'we recommend using 1080x1920 pixel size (9:16 ratio)'.)

source.title: TikTok Auction In-Feed Ads | TikTok Ads Manager
source.quote: Vertical (recommended): 9:16, more than or equal to 540*960px. Horizontal: 16:9, more than or equal to 960*540px. Square: 1:1, more than or equal to 640*640px

facts.text: Non-Spark In-Feed ads: vertical 9:16 (recommended) at 540 x 960 px or more, horizontal 16:9 at 960 x 540 px or more, or square 1:1 at 640 x 640 px or more; .mp4, .mov, .mpeg, .3gp or .avi up to 500 MB.

source.quote: Vertical (recommended) : 9:16, more than or equal to 540*960px. Horizontal : 16:9, more than or equal to 960*540px. Square : 1:1, more than or equal to 640*640px File formats : .mp4, .mov, .mpeg, .3gp .avi. ... File size : Less than or equal to 500 MB.

facts.text: TikTok gives no single pixel figure for the In-Feed ad safe zone: it depends on the ratio, caption length and add-ons, and TikTok provides downloadable safe-zone template files (standard, with anchor, and Arabic RTL versions).

source.quote: The safe zone size is determined by the dimension (vertical, horizontal, or square), ad caption length, and any additional formats used. Downloadable safe zone files are available below.

facts.text: The optional ad profile photo is 98 x 98 px square, .jpg/.jpeg/.png, under 50 KB.

source.quote: Dimension : 98x98px, Square 1:1. File formats : .jpg, .jpeg, .png. File size : less than 50 KB.

facts.text: For the 98 x 98 ad profile photo, keep the key element inside the central 66 x 66 px so it is not cropped.

source.quote: Safe zone : The key element should be in the center of the 66px*66px-sized image to prevent it from being cropped.

facts.text: Carousel (image) ads take 2 to 35 JPG or PNG images at 1200 x 628 (horizontal), 640 x 640 (square) or 720 x 1280 (vertical), with a suggested size of 100 KB or less each.

source.quote: min 2 - max 35 images - JPG/.JPEG or .PNG - File size ≤100 KB suggested - Image resolution: - Horizontal 1200*628px | Square 640*640px | Vertical 720*1280px

items.notes: The 9:16 ratio matches and 1080x1920 is above the 540x960 minimum, but TikTok states only a minimum, not 1080x1920. File size and formats are from the Non-Spark Ads section ('File formats: .mp4, .mov, .mpeg, .3gp .avi.' 'File size: Less than or equal to 500 MB.'), checked against the raw HTML.

facts.text: Static emotes must be square PNGs, up to 1 MB: either one image between 112 x 112 and 4096 x 4096 px (auto-resize) or three images at 28, 56 and 112 px (manual). A fully transparent background is requested.

source.quote: The image must be in a .png format Depending on whether you wish to use auto-resize or manual upload, you will either need a single PNG between 112 x 112px and 4096 x 4096px, or three image sizes: 28 x 28px, 56 x 56px and 112 x 112px. Images must be square shape (e.g., same pixel height and width) The file size cannot exceed 1MB Please submit your emote with a fully transparent background.

facts.text: Animated emotes must be square GIFs (112 to 4096 px for auto-resize, or 28/56/112 px for manual), at most 1 MB in auto-resize mode or 512 KB per file in manual mode, with no more than 60 frames and no more than 3 flashes per second.

source.quote: 1MB file size max for auto-resize mode. If using manual mode, each of the file sizes cannot exceed 512KB ... GIF images cannot be more than 60 frames Must not flash or flicker more than 3 times within a 1 second period

facts.text: In auto-resize mode, Twitch converts the single uploaded image into the other required sizes; the thumbnail of an animated emote defaults to the GIF's first frame.

source.quote: you'll need a single square image file between 112x112px and 4096x4096px that is under 1MB in size. This file will then be automatically converted into our other required sizes.

facts.text: The Subscriber Emote Guide says manual-mode files (28, 56 and 112 px) must each be under 100 KB.

source.quote: Please note that the three sizes you supply for each emote must be of the same image and must each be under 100KB.

facts.text: Emotes are often seen at their smallest, 28 px size, so Twitch warns against too much detail or text.

source.quote: Since you only have 28px to work with, too much detail or too many words can clutter the emote, making it look messy and hard to understand.

items.notes: Official page is client-rendered and returns no content to fetches. Third parties say 112x112 to 4096x4096 square, max 1 MB, PNG/GIF. Unverified; recorded null.

source.title: How to Make and Use Custom Emoji on Discord
source.quote: File type: Use either a JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, or AVIF image. File size: 256 KB. If your emoji's a bit bigger, we'll go ahead and compress it. Dimensions: 128x128. Bigger or smaller will work, but 128x128 is juuuust right.

facts.text: Custom emojis must be under 256 KB, in JPEG, PNG, GIF or WEBP; animated emojis are GIFs.

source.quote: Custom emojis must be under 256KB in size and use supported formats like JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WEBP.

facts.text: Discord's developer docs describe the emoji image as 128 x 128 and cap emoji files at 256 KiB; larger uploads fail.

source.quote: Emojis and animated emojis have a maximum file size of 256 KiB. Attempting to upload an emoji larger than this limit will fail ... image data the 128x128 emoji image

facts.text: Discord's CDN serves avatars, icons, banners and emojis in sizes you request by URL: any power of two from 16 to 4096 px, as PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Animated images uploaded as WebP or AVIF do not convert cleanly to GIF.

source.quote: The returned size can be changed by appending a querystring of ?size=desired_size to the URL. Image size can be any power of two between 16 and 4096. Animated images uploaded as WebP or AVIF do not convert cleanly to GIF.

items.notes: Source is Discord's own blog, not the Help Center (support.discord.com blocks automated fetches).

facts.text: Custom thumbnails can be JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF or PNG; animated GIFs are not supported.

source.quote: Supported file types include: JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, and PNG. While GIF files are supported, animated GIF files are not currently supported.

facts.text: Vimeo slightly compresses uploaded custom thumbnails.

source.quote: Custom thumbnails uploaded undergo slight compression.

facts.text: Vimeo recommends a thumbnail with the exact dimensions of the video, e.g. 1280 x 720 for a 1280 x 720 video.

source.quote: For the best results, we recommend uploading an image with the exact dimensions of your video. Example: If your video's dimensions are 1280x720, we recommend uploading an image that is 1280px x 720px.

facts.text: At least 80% of the thumbnail must have an alpha (transparency) level above 250, since Google does not permit transparent thumbnails for video indexing.

source.quote: At a minimum, 80% of the image must have an alpha (transparency) level above 250 . Google does not permit transparent thumbnails for video indexing.

items.notes: no official source could be read. The Vimeo Help Center article IDs found via search return 404. Third parties say Vimeo recommends matching the video's dimensions (so a 16:9 1080p video gives 1920x1080), but this is unverified.

facts.text: In the new page editor Patreon recommends a cover at least 1600 x 400 px, JPEG or PNG, 3 MB or less (legacy editor: 16 MB).

source.quote: we recommend that your image be at least 1600 x 400 pixels , and the supported formats are JPEG or PNG ... New page editor: Your upload file sizes must be 3 MB or less per image. Legacy page editor: Your upload file sizes must be 16 MB or less per image.

facts.text: At its maximum view the cover photo is displayed at 1600 x 400 pixels; smaller images still work but may look slightly pixelated.

source.quote: In its maximum view, the cover photo will be displayed at 1600 x 400 pixels . We recommend using a wide image that's at least the suggested size. Although smaller sizes will still work, they may appear to be slightly pixelated.

facts.text: Keep key visuals centred and away from the edges, because narrower screens may crop the sides (no pixel safe area is given).

source.quote: we recommend keeping key visuals centered and avoiding placing important details near the edges, since narrower screens may crop the sides.

facts.text: The Patreon app shows the profile photo as the main image, not the cover image.

source.quote: Right now, the Patreon app features your profile photo as the main image, which is separate from your cover image.

facts.text: After upload you can crop the image by moving the dots around the desired area.

source.quote: Once uploaded, you'll be able to crop the image if you want to. To adjust the size, move the dots around the desired area.

items.notes: support.patreon.com blocks fetches (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare challenge); not verified.

facts.text: Project cover images are displayed at 202 x 158 px; upload at least 808 x 632 px (for retina) and crop with Behance's cropping tool.

source.quote: Your Cover Image will display at 202x158 px, but you must upload an image that is at least 808x632px. This is so that your Cover Image will look great on retina display screens. Once you upload an image, you can use our cropping tool to cut it down to the exact size.

facts.text: GIF is accepted only for project content, not project covers; JPEG (recommended) and PNG are accepted.

source.quote: GIF (only for project content, not project covers)

facts.text: Official Account image assets: up to 10 MB in BMP, PNG, JPEG, JPG or GIF; thumbnail assets up to 64 KB, JPG only.

source.quote: 图片（image）: 10M，支持bmp/png/jpeg/jpg/gif格式 ... 缩略图（thumb）：64KB，支持JPG格式

facts.text: An article (news) cover is cropped to two shapes: 2.35:1 and 1:1. Image posts (newspic) can use 1:1, 16:9 or 2.35:1 crops.

source.quote: 裁剪比例。图文消息（news）仅支持“2.35_1”“1_1”；图片消息（newspic）支持“1_1”“16_9”“2.35_1”

facts.text: Images inside the article body must be uploaded through WeChat's article-image API (JPG/PNG under 1 MB); WeChat filters out external image links.

source.quote: 图片仅支持jpg/png格式，大小必须在1MB以下。

facts.text: WeChat strips external image URLs from article content.

source.quote: 涉及图片url必须来源 "上传图文消息内的图片获取URL"接口获取。外部图片url将被过滤。

facts.text: Uploaded permanent images get a URL that only works on Tencent domains; elsewhere the image is blocked.

source.quote: 开发者可以在腾讯系域名内使用（腾讯系域名外使用，图片将被屏蔽）。

items.notes: no official source found. 900x383 (2.35:1) appears only in third-party guides (Canva China and others); one source cites 900x500.

facts.text: In its 2018 profile redesign, LINE made the profile cover image larger and turned it from landscape to portrait. The cover is generally 720 x 1280 px, and the visible area varies with screen size and image resolution.

source.quote: the update will enlarge the cover image to a more smartphone-friendly display size, and rotate it from landscape to portrait-mode. ... While the cover image size will generally be 720 by 1280 pixels following the update, the display area may slightly differ depending on each device’s screen size and image resolution.

facts.text: After the 2018 redesign, the profile icon sits in the centre of the cover with the display name, status message and background music.

source.quote: Next, the profile icon will be displayed in the center, along with the user's display name, status message, and background music.

items.notes: no official source found (not researched in depth; low priority).

facts.text: Kakao says the profile background size differs by device: the image is adjusted to fit each device, so Kakao gives no specific size.

source.quote: 프로필 배경 사진의 사이즈는 사용하는 기기마다 다르며 기기에 맞춰 변경되어 설정됩니다. 현재 사용하는 기기마다 다르므로 구체적인 안내가 어려운 점 양해 부탁드리겠습니다.

facts.text: A moving profile is set from a GIF or a video picked from the phone's album.

source.quote: 움직이는 프로필로 설정할 gif 혹은 동영상을 선택하여 편집해 주세요.

facts.text: Kakao's 2019 update grew the profile background from about half the screen to the full page.

source.quote: 화면의 절반가량을 차지하던 프로필 배경 영역이 페이지 전체로 확대되어, 더 넓은 범위에서 배경 이미지 설정이 가능해졌다.

items.notes: no official source found (not researched in depth; low priority).

facts.text: Tumblr's ideal header image is 2048 x 1152 px (16:9), up to 10 MB, in JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF.

source.quote: Header image: The ideal image size is 2048x1152px (16:9 aspect ratio) and a file size no larger than 10MB. Supported file formats are JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and GIFs.

items.notes: no official source found; 3000x1055 appears only in third-party guides.

facts.text: Space icon: 500 x 500 px recommended. Space cover photo: 1:4 ratio, shown as a banner at the top of the Space.

source.quote: Icon (500x500 pixels recommended): Upload an image or logo that visually describes your Space. Cover Photo (1:4 ratio) : Upload an image that will appear as a banner at the top of your Space.
